insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Be-You-Tiful Athletics delivered $360 in total sales for Week 46, up 91.6% from $188 the prior week, on 13 units. The Dark Gray BE SECURE Hot Yoga Towel led at $218 (+98.3%) with units up 100.0% to 6, and the BE YOU Sling & Stretch Strap grew 66.7% to $70 at a 9.3% CVR. Wednesday, Nov 11 was the peak day at $146.

**Metrics to Watch —** Organic sales reached $152 this week, a solid lift in non-ad demand. The Light Gray towel drew 81 sessions (+68.8%) at a 1.2% CVR and the Blue towel 55 sessions (+37.5%) at 1.8%, while the 6mm Black yoga mat had 44 sessions without a sale; Thu Nov 12 and Sat Nov 14 came in at $0.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** Ad spend of $463 (prior $417) generated $208 in PPC revenue for a 0.45x ROAS and 223.0% ACOS. TACoS improved to 128.6% from 221.90% as total sales grew, with a 0.20% ad CTR and 2.83% ad conversion. Lifting ad efficiency is our top priority this week.

**Actions This Week —** We will lower bids on non-converting yoga mat targets and add negative keywords on search terms that spend without sales, reallocating budget to the Dark Gray towel and Sling & Stretch Strap, which converted at 7.9% and 9.3%. We will also test new Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands ad creative to lift the 0.20% ad CTR heading into the holiday season.
